summary: Ebang International Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting that on September 28, 2026, its indirectly wholly-owned subsidiary won a bid for state-owned construction land use rights in Meishan Town, Changxing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China. The parcel covers roughly 66,731 square meters (about 718,286 square feet), with a transfer price of RMB 27,230,000 (approximately US$4 million), payable in full within 30 days of contract execution. Delivery is expected by December 28, 2026, with a 50-year term. This is an ordinary asset purchase tied to manufacturing expansion, not a special situation; development covenants on investment, production, and environmental/energy compliance carry forfeiture and liquidated-damages risk.
